o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *yïlkï (“age, grown-up animal”).
Cognate with Kazakh жылқы (jılqı), Bashkir йылҡы (yılqı), Turkish yılkı.
From dolanmaq + -mac. Compare gizlənpaç (“hide and seek”) and atlanbac (“leapfrog”).
